_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Integrated Circuit Test Documentation
summary: The Integrated Circuit Test Documentation documents the procedures for manual and automated testing of integrated circuits, covering strategy, techniques, programs, and equipment.
description_purpose: 3.1 This data will document the procedures for the manual and automated test of integrated circuits. This documentation will provide information to allow full understanding of the testing strategy, techniques, programs, and specific equipment (commercial and unique) employed.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.2 This DID is usually used in conjunction with the following DIDs: DI-MCCR-80499 (Integrated Data, Computer Aided Chip Development); DI-MCCR-80500 (Integrated Circuit Data, Computer Aided Cell Development); and DI-T-5477A (Parts Qualification Test Plan).

7.3 This DID supersedes DI-E-5432A.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The documentation may be in the contractor's format.

children.title: Documentation.
children.content: The documentation shall be presented in a logical and comprehensive order and consist of all manual and automated test procedures for parametric, functional, and dynamic testing of wafers, chips, and hybrid devices. It shall include:

children.title: Source code (alphanumeric) of the test software programs
Performance Board Documentation.
children.content: The performance board documentation shall fully describe the loading and interfacing requirements necessary between the device being tested and the tester itself, and include any other unique or related tester documentation, such as burn-in and life test circuitry.

children.title: Commercial.
children.content: If the automated tester is a commercially available system, the documentation shall include:

children.title: A magnetic tape containing both source and executable code
A hardcopy printout of the source code.
A directory listing of all files and their order on the digital media.
The release level of the software.
The model number of the tester.
Contractor developed.
children.content: If the program is a unique contractor developed program, the documentation shall include:

children.title: The program source code on a nine track magnetic tape, 1600 PI, odd parity, and in ASCII format.
A directory listing the files and their order on the digital media.
Title page.
children.content: The alphanumeric source code printout of the test software program shall contain a title page with the following information:

children.title: Labeling.
children.content: The digital media shall be labeled with the following information:

children.title: Number of files on the tape
